  const image=builder.querySelector('.jscv-photo'),placeholder=builder.querySelector('.jscv-placeholder'),placeholderCopy=builder.querySelector('.jscv-placeholder-copy'),name=builder.querySelector('.jscv-name'),caption=builder.querySelector('.jscv-caption-model'),description=builder.querySelector('.jscv-description'),specs=builder.querySelector('.jscv-specs'),trimSelect=builder.querySelector('.jscv-select'),trimTitle=builder.querySelector('.jscv-trim-title'),trimCopy=builder.querySelector('.jscv-trim-copy'),featureList=builder.querySelector('.jscv-features'),colours=builder.querySelector('.jscv-colours'),colourName=builder.querySelector('.jscv-colour-name'),priceValue=builder.querySelector('.jscv-price-value'),smsLink=builder.querySelector('.jscv-secondary'),primaryLink=builder.querySelector('.jscv-primary'),galleryNav=builder.querySelector('.jscv-gallery-nav'),galleryStatus=builder.querySelector('.jscv-gallery-status'),galleryPrev=builder.querySelector('.jscv-gallery-prev'),galleryNext=builder.querySelector('.jscv-gallery-next');
  const brochureLink=builder.querySelector('.jscv-brochure'),extraBrochure=builder.querySelector('.jscv-extra-brochure');
  let selectedModel='outlander-phev',selectedColour='',galleryViews=[],galleryIndex=0,currentStep=1;
  const progressItems=[...builder.querySelectorAll('.jscv-steps li')];
  function updateSteps(){progressItems.forEach((item,index)=>{const current=index===currentStep-1,complete=index<currentStep-1;item.classList.toggle('is-current',current);item.classList.toggle('is-complete',complete);if(current)item.setAttribute('aria-current','step');else item.removeAttribute('aria-current')})}
  const normalizeColour=s=>s.replace(/\s*\/\s*/g,' / ').trim();
  const money=value=>new Intl.NumberFormat('en-CA',{style:'currency',currency:'CAD',maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(value);
  function showView(){const current=galleryViews[galleryIndex];if(!current){image.removeAttribute('src');image.hidden=true;placeholder.hidden=false;placeholderCopy.textContent='No verified Mitsubishi image is available for this selection.';galleryNav.hidden=true;return}image.src=current.url;image.alt=`${VEHICLES[selectedModel].year||2026} Mitsubishi ${VEHICLES[selectedModel].name} ${trimSelect.value} in ${selectedColour}, ${current.label.toLowerCase()}`;image.hidden=false;placeholder.hidden=true;galleryStatus.textContent=`${galleryIndex+1} / ${galleryViews.length} · ${current.label}`;galleryNav.hidden=galleryViews.length<2;galleryPrev.disabled=galleryIndex===0;galleryNext.disabled=galleryIndex===galleryViews.length-1}
  function setGallery(render,imageUrl){galleryIndex=0;galleryViews=render?.views?.length?render.views.map(view=>({url:view.url.replace('{COLOR}',render.currentCode),label:view.label})):imageUrl?[{url:imageUrl,label:'Side profile'}]:[];showView()}
  function renderColours(){const v=VEHICLES[selectedModel],render=TRIM_RENDER[selectedModel]?.[trimSelect.selectedIndex];let list=[];if(render){list=render.colors.split('|').map(pair=>{const [colour,code]=pair.split(':');const paint=v.colours.find(c=>normalizeColour(c.name)===normalizeColour(colour));return{name:colour,hex:paint?.hex||'#777',image:render.url.replace('{COLOR}',code),code}}).filter(c=>c.image)}else{list=v.colours}if(!list.some(c=>normalizeColour(c.name)===normalizeColour(selectedColour)))selectedColour=list[0]?.name||'';colours.replaceChildren(...list.map(c=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='jscv-swatch';b.dataset.colour=c.name;b.dataset.image=c.image||'';b.setAttribute('aria-label',`View ${c.name}`);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');const dot=document.createElement('span');dot.className='jscv-dot';dot.style.setProperty('--swatch',c.hex);dot.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');const label=document.createElement('span');label.textContent=c.name.replace(/\s*\/\s*/g,'/');b.append(dot,label);b.addEventListener('click',()=>{currentStep=3;updateSteps();updateColour(c.name,c.image,render,c.code)});return b}));const current=list.find(c=>normalizeColour(c.name)===normalizeColour(selectedColour));updateColour(selectedColour,current?.image,render,current?.code)}
  function updateContact(){const v=VEHICLES[selectedModel],t=v.trims[trimSelect.selectedIndex];const label=(v.year||2026)+' Mitsubishi '+v.name+(t?' '+t.name:'');const vehicle=(label+', '+(selectedColour||'colour: open to options')+(t?', '+money(t.msrp)+' MSRP':'')).slice(0,160);smsLink.href='sms:+17783631453?body='+encodeURIComponent('Hi Jayson, I’m interested in the '+label+'. Colour preference: '+(selectedColour||'open to options')+'. Can you tell me about availability and arrange a test drive?');if(primaryLink)primaryLink.href='https://www.jaysonsellscarsandtrucks.ca/contact-us?topic='+encodeURIComponent('Book a test drive')+'&vehicle='+encodeURIComponent(vehicle)+'#jsccf-topic'}
  function updateTrim(){const v=VEHICLES[selectedModel],t=v.trims[trimSelect.selectedIndex];trimTitle.textContent=`${t.name} · trim highlights`;trimCopy.textContent=t.copy;priceValue.textContent=money(t.msrp);featureList.replaceChildren(...t.features.map(f=>{const li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=f;return li}));renderColours();updateContact()}
  function updateColour(nameValue,imageUrl,render,code){selectedColour=nameValue;colourName.textContent=nameValue||'Choose a colour to see its name';colours.querySelectorAll('.jscv-swatch').forEach(b=>{const on=normalizeColour(b.dataset.colour)===normalizeColour(selectedColour);b.classList.toggle('is-selected',on);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on));if(on){if(!imageUrl)imageUrl=b.dataset.image;if(code===undefined)code=render?.colors.split('|').find(pair=>normalizeColour(pair.split(':')[0])===normalizeColour(selectedColour))?.split(':')[1]}});if(render&&code)render.currentCode=code;setGallery(render,imageUrl);updateContact()}
  function updateModel(key){const v=VEHICLES[key];if(!v)return;selectedModel=key;brochureLink.href=v.brochure;brochureLink.hidden=!v.brochure;brochureLink.setAttribute('aria-label',`Download the ${v.year||2026} ${v.name} brochure`);extraBrochure.hidden=key!=='rvr';builder.dataset.selectedModel=key;name.textContent=`${v.year||2026} ${v.name}`;caption.textContent=v.name;description.textContent=v.description;specs.replaceChildren(...v.specs.map(s=>{const el=document.createElement('span');el.className='jscv-spec';el.textContent=s;return el}));image.removeAttribute('src');image.hidden=true;placeholder.hidden=false;placeholderCopy.textContent='Loading matched Mitsubishi studio image';trimSelect.replaceChildren(...v.trims.map((t,i)=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=t.name;o.textContent=`${t.name} · ${money(t.msrp)} MSRP${i===0?' · starting trim':''}`;return o}));builder.querySelectorAll('.jscv-model[data-model]').forEach(b=>{const on=b.dataset.model===key;b.classList.toggle('is-active',on);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on))});selectedColour='';trimSelect.selectedIndex=0;updateTrim()}
  image.addEventListener('error',()=>{image.hidden=true;placeholder.hidden=false;placeholderCopy.textContent='Mitsubishi’s matching studio image is temporarily unavailable. View this vehicle on Mitsubishi Canada.'});
  galleryPrev.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(galleryIndex>0){galleryIndex--;showView()}});galleryNext.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(galleryIndex<galleryViews.length-1){galleryIndex++;showView()}});
  builder.querySelectorAll('.jscv-model[data-model]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{currentStep=2;updateSteps();updateModel(b.dataset.model)}));trimSelect.addEventListener('change',()=>{currentStep=3;updateSteps();updateTrim()});updateSteps();updateModel(selectedModel);
})();
